answer: In our consensus layer, sybil resistance is anchored in hardware: each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), ensuring adversaries cannot forge ephemeral validator states through simple virtual machine duplication. An attacker seeking to spawn rogue nodes cannot merely kindle a digital ember in memory; cloning identities demands procuring physical silicon, treating each enclave like an ivory vault backed by distinct hardware root keys.
